chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Kufi from Ubeys ibn Hisham from Muawiya ibn Ammar from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Good neighbourliness builds the households and prolongs the life-spans.

key_terms.حُسْنُ الْجِوَارِ: Good neighbourliness / Excellence in neighbourly conduct

ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual benefits of good neighbourliness in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, this hadith links ethical neighbourly conduct (husn al-jiwar) to tangible divine blessings, specifically the prosperity of dwellings and longevity of life. It underscores the Shia emphasis on social cohesion, where moral rights of neighbours are seen as a means of sustaining communal stability and individual well-being.

en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Kufy, from Ubeys Bin Hisham, from Muawiya Bin Ammar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Good neighbourliness builds the households, and cause (death to be) forgotten regarding the life-spans’.
en.sarwar: 9. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from certain individuals of his people from Salih ibn Hamza from al-Hassan ibn ‘Abd Allah from ‘Abd Salih (a.s.) who has said the following: “
Not to cause suffering to neighbors is not a good neighborly relation, however, to be a good neighbor and to exercise patience in suffering (caused by the neighbors) is a good neighborly relations.”
